_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source presets for fan-manager (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Fan Manager's primary native ingestion is the direct-push MCP tool 'fan_ingest_telemetry' (kg_ingest.py), which writes :TemperatureReading/:SensorReading timeseries nodes straight into the engine. This declarative preset is the secondary source-sync leg: it lists the live IPMI SDR sensor rows via the fan-manager MCP server and mirrors them as sensor-telemetry documents. Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS.
